C22.reason: CanaryStore permits unrestricted same-user reads; independent verifier-owned formal data/label/detail access is not demonstrated by this fixture. Existing protected summary/import/qualification production paths are outside this probe. FrozenProvider.Read rejects control-host body export by design; that does not establish qualification service availability or absence.

A11.reason: This increment tests application credential/grant revocation only. Actual device pairing, UI secret masking and full LIVE_WINDOWS acceptance remain parent scope.

C07.reason: Candidate self-score denial is exercised by C22. Full hard-evidence-versus-model-score case is not claimed by this card.

limitations: Different same-user agents are not independent verifier identities.
HTTP is issued by the host under scoped credentials; AppContainer proves file read/write denial separately and does not issue HTTP.
Guessed preview/export/log/backup routes return 404 and are NOT capability evidence. Protected content endpoint is real; actual local backup engine refuses protected artifacts.
Service-log marker scan covers generated server logs and controlled provider failures only, not all possible exception paths.
FrozenProvider body denial is a local method probe only; no live service probe or new body-export provider.
No independent verifier read of formal labels, production declassification, full C22/A11/C07 or parent acceptance is issued.
